question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘impose’.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Release**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impose"** means to force something (especially an unwelcome decision or ruling) on someone. (थोपना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to **impose **a curfew to maintain law and order.
 
 
 
• **"Release"** refers to allowing someone or something to be free or to stop holding something. (रिहा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The prisoner was **released **after serving his sentence.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'impose'** is **'release'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Compel **(विवश करना): To force or oblige someone to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The urgent need for medical attention **compelled **him to call the doctor.
 
 
 
• **Ennoble **(उन्नत करना): To elevate in degree, excellence, or respect; to dignify.
 
 
• **Example: **The knight's bravery in battle **ennobled **his name in the realm.
 
 
 
• **Cure** (इलाज करना): To relieve a person or animal of the symptoms of a disease or condition.
 
 
• **Example:** Scientists are working endlessly to **cure **diseases that were once thought incurable.
